A collection of reusable [Dev Container Features](https://containers.dev/implementors/features/) for development tools and workflows, published to the GitHub Container Registry.

## Features

Each feature can be added to `devcontainer.json` from `ghcr.io/MiguelRodo/DevContainerFeatures/<feature-name>`. This catalogue is generated from `src/<feature>/devcontainer-feature.json`.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED FEATURE CATALOGUE -->
| Feature | Status | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| [`apptainer`](features/apptainer.qmd) | Current | Install Apptainer, a container system for HPC |
| [`build-info`](features/build-info.qmd) | Current | Bakes build-time release version and date metadata directly into a system-wide command. |
| [`cmdstan`](features/cmdstan.qmd) | Current | Installs CmdStan (the Stan probabilistic programming system command-line interface) from the official GitHub release, compiles it during image build, and configures the CMDSTAN environment variable system-wide so the installation survives container rebuilds. |
| [`fit-sne`](features/fit-sne.qmd) | Current | Installs FIt-SNE (Fast Interpolation-based t-SNE) by compiling from source. |
| [`github-tokens`](features/github-tokens.qmd) | Current | Manage GitHub authentication tokens (GITHUB_PAT, GITHUB_TOKEN) on each shell startup |
| [`mermaid`](features/mermaid.qmd) | Current | Installs Mermaid CLI to generate diagrams. Sets up a non-root user and Puppeteer configuration. |
| [`renv-cache`](features/renv-cache.qmd) | Current | Configure R with renv cache |
| [`repos`](features/repos.qmd) | Deprecated | (DEPRECATED: Use the 'utils' feature instead) Installs the 'repos' CLI tool to manage multiple Git repositories. Optionally runs 'repos clone' when the container starts to clone repositories defined in repos.list. |
| [`utils`](features/utils.qmd) | Current | Installs Miguel Rodo's utilities like 'repos' and 'setupmjr'. |
<!-- END GENERATED FEATURE CATALOGUE -->

The deprecated `repos` feature remains available for existing configurations. Use [`utils`](features/utils.qmd) for new work.

## Quick Start

```json
{
  "image": "mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base:ubuntu",
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/MiguelRodo/DevContainerFeatures/<feature-name>:1": {}
  }
}
```

Feature pages document the available options. Their option names and defaults are checked against the canonical feature metadata in CI.
